scope: Durable finite-slot claim and held-only settlement helper; no dispatch
trustedCLI: Fixed order-ledger.json and existing prepareOrder; JSON request cannot override ledger/preparer
atomicity: Exclusive lock, expected revision SHA, prepare under lock, consumed slot/token/requestSHA/counters, fsync temporary ledger then atomic rename and directory fsync
settlement: Matching used slot token required; output bytes SHA verified; success/failure both held, approval false
recovery: No automatic retry or stale lock reset. Claim remains used after dispatch crash. Human custody review required for uncertain dispatch.
preservation: Actual ledger/registries/images/runtime untouched; temp test fixtures removed
limitations: All future callers must use this helper for reservation; prepareOrder remains read-only and cannot prevent bypass
Not an image dispatcher or visual approval gate
